input_modality: full mature mRNA input; sequence-only UTR-only parity not assumed
hold_reason: Public collection bytes or catalog available under an explicit collection-license claim; original assay/batch/cell/readout identity, original rights review, group splits/leakage and full QC remain unverified.
next_action: Bind downloaded version/file to original assay DOI/accession, original observation and registered task; review rights and official group split before human admission. File N is not task N.

assets.rights_scope: Requires asset-specific acquisition decision, never blanket task approval

baseline_plan.最低信息Baseline: miRNA-only 和 target-only shortcut controls；pair random
baseline_plan.经典算法Baseline: RNAcofold 最低自由能；seed match / TargetScan features
baseline_plan.随机初始化Baseline: paired Siamese CNN 或双塔模型随机初始化
baseline_plan.泄露检查重点: miRNA 家族、靶基因和同 pair 重复、负例采样差异

download_policy: Source-entry links are not file bytes. Explicit package-only opt-in required before file candidates can be acquired for audit.
